You, whose very fate is cursed with this sickness...

... were capable of love. Even as your mind ailed from this suffocating, parching thirst...
即便身处令人窒息的饥渴之中，你仍在思考着爱……

That is why you saved my life from the periphery of death... tried to share your love...
这就是为何你从死亡边缘将我救下……想与我分享爱……

We shall receive no assistance, Bloodfiend or not! This shall be us two against the world.
无论谁！连血魔都不会来帮助我们，只能靠我们自己闯过去。

I know.
我知道。

dataList.content:
I suppose we will encounter many knights on our journey; many of whom shall challenge me to a duel. You will watch my back when the time comes, won't you? You must strike our foes with a heart that knows no fear.
我们应该会遇到许多骑士吧，或许还会接到决斗申请。到那时候你可要守望好我的背后。明白吗？必须心怀无所畏惧的感情去攻击。

Ah, and how could I forget? From this moment onward, we must abandon our identities as Bloodfiends as well.
此外，从此刻开始，我们必须放弃身为血魔的身份。

In other words, we must appear and behave as humans do.
像人类一样行动。

... I know that as well. That is why you have transformed your Rocinante into the shape of a horse, as awkward as it may appear.
……我知道。所以才把驽骍难得也变成了马的形状，虽然看起来比较尴尬。

It used to have such a beautiful, flowing mane of blood...
它本来有着血做的非常帅气地飘舞着的鬃毛来着……
Whinny... 咴……

Alas. Even Rocinante finds this appearance unpleasant. Sighing and exhaling, so unlike itself...
看到了吧，驽骍难得到底是对自己的外形有多不满意才会发出这种叹息声……

Do you even know where this elusive 'tavern' is supposed to be?

我和您一样都整天窝在城里，上哪儿去知道？

I thought we were to appear and behave as humans do? This is supposed to be an adventure, after all.
不是说要像人类一样思考吗？您说了这是冒险吧。

Oh, please. Where is the fun in that? We shall battle this fell beast like the battles in which the Fixers from the books have struggled so valiantly!

Our adventure then... was full of amateurish mistakes and foolhardy confidence, but...

We shall feast on bear meat as well!

dataList.content:
Yet thou shalt hew open a path, cleaving the shadows in twain.
也要穿越这片黑暗。

With the blessings and approval of our family of which there is no equal,
承蒙此世独一无二家族之祝福与应允，

Challenge and vanquish all things perilous.
跨越一切艰难险阻。

And at last—reach true happiness.
终将获得幸福。

Thus how indubitable.
不容置疑。

The magnificence with which mine ingenious adventures of to-day shall shine.
今天我要经历的，也将是一次不可思议的冒险。

Which is... our adventure, as well.
而且……也会是属于我们的冒险。

You remember the words, right? A Fixer must maintain a head clear of corruption, speech free of deceit, and conduct guided by clemency.
大家都还记得吧？凡收尾人……当思想纯粹、言语真诚、行事宽容。

Show courage in adventure, and bear pain in suffering.
于冒险中须勇敢、于苦难中现坚韧。

And pray, forget not the mercy for the downtrodden...
对身陷困境之人须心怀怜悯。

... and last but not least...
最后……

... Pursue your dream, even if it means wagering your life in the chase.
即便拼上性命，也要去追逐梦想。

And we'll return here and talk all about it, no matter how many moons it takes.
然后再回到此地，将彼此所经历的旅程。

About all the wonderful adventures we've undertaken.
毫无保留地告诉对方。

Even if I were to lose my mind...
即使精神失常……

dataList.content:
Even if all this is just a fake steed running in circles on a carousel… I don’t want to stop...
即使只是原地打转的旋转木马……但我仍想继续奔跑下去……

Even if it means that you must struggle against this incurable disease? Even if you must stand against your own blood, your Father?
